method: Opt-in keyFrame clearStrongConnectedGreen. Strongly green-dominant pixels in existing connected green regions are fully transparent instead of retaining alpha from a global brightness estimate. Connected regions include border flood-fill and strict saturated interior seeds for hair holes. No geometry erosion, blur, watermark masks, or redraw.
qaLayout: Left = previous matte; right = rekeyed matte; upper = light background, lower = dark. Main QA is full-frame for square inputs. Detail QA is 360px on the left hair edge; crops are inspection only.
limitations: This is a color matte, not semantic segmentation. Strong green clothing or props would need a protected mask; this character has no such clothing.
Highly green-dominant mixed edge pixels may become transparent. Review fine hairs on light and dark backgrounds before runtime use.
All watermarks and non-green overlays are retained and can affect frame bounds.
